item.title: Crossing Half a Continent
item.description: I’m no stranger to big moves. When I first did my masters, I moved all the way from Chile to Estonia carrying, I think, one 23 kilo bag and a large backpack. And then, after finishing my PhD, I had to undo the move and head back to Chile. Then I moved back again, this time to the Czech Republic. Once again carrying a single 23kg bag, though I want to think my packing was smarter that time (less books in the bag, more books in my e-reader).

item.title: Murcia
item.description: I’m relocating to Murcia, Spain, for the beginning of a project! I will write a bit more about it once the dust settles! Very excited!

item.title: ISH25 Porto
item.description: I’m currently at the ISHPSSB 2025 conference! And there is a small chance you got here because maybe you saw a slide somewhere, so I just wanted to say hi!
